verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party Structured Outputs docs say model responses conform to a provided JSON Schema, and with strict: true constrained decoding guarantees the output always matches the schema exactly, which directly delivers reliable parsing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of strict-mode reliability, documentation of which models and schema features support strict constrained decoding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably

citations.quote: Structured Outputs is a feature that ensures your model responses conform to your provided JSON Schema
With strict: true, the model uses constrained decoding to guarantee that the output will always match your schema exactly.
Guarantee model responses strictly conform to your JSON schema for reliable, type-safe data structures.
